descriptions.shortDescription: Gateway and service bus for Nextcloud: synchronise data sources, send cloud events, and map API calls.
descriptions.longDescription: Integriq brings gateway and service bus functionality to Nextcloud. It provides an ESB-framework for working together in an open data ecosystem: synchronise external data sources, emit cloud events, and translate API calls through configurable mappings.

descriptions.shortDescription: Gateway en servicebus voor Nextcloud: synchroniseer databronnen, verstuur cloud events en vertaal API-aanroepen.
descriptions.longDescription: Integriq biedt gateway- en servicebusfunctionaliteit voor Nextcloud. Het levert een ESB-raamwerk voor samenwerking in een open data-ecosysteem: synchroniseer externe databronnen, publiceer cloud events en vertaal API-aanroepen via configureerbare mappings.

results.message: 6 of 6 CHAOSS metrics measured. They are shown for information and do not count in any rating.

metrics.name: Contributor Absence Factor
metrics.explanation: The fewest people who together made half of the commits on the default branch in the last 12 months, of the 100 contributors GitHub reports, among 10 human contributors. At 1 the project depends on a single person. Bots are left out; one person with several accounts or addresses counts more than once.

metrics.name: Organizational Diversity
metrics.explanation: Organisations are told apart by the email domain of the latest 300 commits of the last 12 months (250 commits by people, after the .mailmap) and, for a personal or hidden address, by the company on the author's public profile. The largest is conduction.nl (5 authors), with 97% of the 248 commits whose organisation is known; 1% of the commits come from 2 of 8 authors whose organisation stays unknown. Only these counts are kept, no names, addresses or companies; an organisation is named only when several authors share it.

metrics.name: Change Request Closure Ratio
metrics.explanation: 1,903 change requests were closed (merged or not) and 1,997 opened in the last 90 days, bots included. Below 1 the open backlog grows; above 1 it shrinks.

metrics.name: Time to First Response
metrics.explanation: None of the 15 latest change requests opened by people between 2026-08-21 and 2026-11-12 got a comment or review from anyone but its author.

metrics.name: Issue Response Time

metrics.name: Release Frequency
